label: weak: start of copy when first token is c/0/2/u
explanation: Sparse (about 1% of steps), diffuse unit. About 40% of activation mass is at the <DEL> step and another 23% at the first copy step. Activity is enriched when the first original token is c, 0, 2 or u, for longer sequences (L 8-9), and for inputs u/e/2/h. It rarely fires at t=0-1. No predicate built from these signals gets dev F1 above about 0.2, and the best is a conjunction of start-of-copy, first token in {c,0,2,u} and L>=7. Even at <DEL> the rate is only 4.7%. The unit seems to depend on a fine-grained mix of token identities that a simple rule does not capture.
